mapper.sql:
WHERE p.camp_id = #{campId} AND p.status = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM channel_poi_rel rel JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = rel.account_id AND ca.camp_id = rel.camp_id WHERE rel.camp_id = p.camp_id AND rel.poi_id = p.poi_id AND rel.sync_status = 'synced' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ca.config_json, '$.channelCode')) = #{channelCode} )
AND ( p.poi_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT CAST(p.poi_id AS CHAR) AS poiId, rel.out_poi_id AS outPoiId, p.poi_name AS poiName, p.address AS address, CASE WHEN p.status = 1 THEN 'enabled' ELSE 'disabled' END AS status FROM pms_poi p JOIN channel_poi_rel rel ON rel.camp_id = p.camp_id AND rel.poi_id = p.poi_id AND rel.sync_status = 'synced' JOIN channel_account ca ON ca.account_id = rel.account_id AND ca.camp_id = rel.camp_id AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ca.config_json, '$.channelCode')) = #{channelCode}
ORDER BY p.poi_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
